# Elysium Labs

> Elysium Labs is a web design and development studio in George, on the Garden Route,
> Western Cape, South Africa. We design and build websites, landing pages, playable brand
> games, apps and 3D web experiences end to end — for guest houses and local businesses
> that refuse to look ordinary.

## What we do
- **Websites & landing pages** — designed, written and live in days; built to convert.
- **Guest house & accommodation websites** — fast, mobile-first sites that take direct bookings.
- **Games & interactive** — playable brand experiences with physics, prizes and leaderboards.
- **Apps & software** — score apps, dashboards and lead-qualifying tools.
- **3D & motion** — WebGL scenes and animation.
- **Care & hosting** — ongoing hosting and maintenance from R350 / month.

## Where we work
Based in George. We serve George, Wilderness, Knysna, Sedgefield, Mossel Bay, Oudtshoorn
and the wider Garden Route and Western Cape. Remote-friendly across South Africa.

## Who it's for
Guest houses, restaurants, dental and medical practices, contractors, retailers and other
local businesses that want a site that stands out and performs.
